constraints: Works regardless of the picture's original stored format inside the BLOB (like READ PICTURE FILE, but from a BLOB instead of a file).
codec lets you force interpretation of the BLOB's bytes using a specific picture codec ID instead of auto-detecting the format.

overloadMerges.note: picture is documented/arrow-marked as an output ('<-', the command fills the picture variable/field), not an input, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.name: picture
params.description: Filled with the picture decoded from pictureBlob.

params.name: codec
params.description: Picture codec ID to force when decoding pictureBlob.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Decodes a picture stored (in any native format) inside pictureBlob into the picture variable/field.
